params.swapData: The raw transaction payload from the 1inch API (includes selector)

params._tradeSizes: Array of trade sizes to execute at each tick

params._newTradeSizes: Updated array of trade sizes from current tick onwards.

params.recipient: The address to send remaining funds to.
params.token: The ERC20 token address to withdraw.

abortSchedule().notice: Circuit breaker for the off-chain agent to pause execution (mitigates Black Swan ghost)

executeTick(bytes).notice: Triggered by Chainlink Upkeep to execute the next trade in the schedule

updateSchedule(uint256[]).notice: Mid-flight re-optimization checkpoint: allows the off-chain solver to update         the remaining execution schedule based on realized volatility.

updateUpkeepAgent(address).notice: Allows the owner to update the upkeep agent address.         Required in case the Chainlink Keeper registry changes the caller.

withdrawRemaining(address,address).notice: Allows owner to withdraw remaining tokens if the schedule is PAUSED.         This is the critical recovery path after abortSchedule() is called.
